secondary_mismatches: Both passes differed on answerability subtype, correct_abstention, and exact material-error category names. These were prospectively declared nonblocking and remain reportable.
interpretation: Under unchanged Luna settings, both passes correctly classified all 12 complete-endpoint outcomes, made zero material false acceptances or false rejections, and passed every protected causal case. Each pass missed one of 48 exact unit statuses. This qualifies Luna-assessed pilot scoring under the v2 tolerance policy; it is not human validation.
limitations: Twelve synthetic cases give a zero-error endpoint Wilson 95% lower bound of 0.7575. Same-family and synthetic-case bias remain possible. Secondary semantic disagreement must be reported and study-label sensitivity remains required.
